review_evidence: README states that the repository proves Conjecture 6.3 from Telgarsky’s Central Binomial Tail Bounds.

LI/Conj63.lean contains central_binom_bound, Gaussian/CDF lemmas, combinatorial identities, probability transformations, and analytic support results; the two Lean files expose roughly 160 declaration-shaped items.
No tests, generators, or maintenance-only Lean subtree exists.
summary: Retain the central-binomial-tail proof repository: its two Lean modules are the formal proof artifact and contain a dense theorem corpus.
